text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to craft a strategy suited for 
Nakayama Festa, the Trainer sought 
cooperation from her former homeroom 
teacher to analyze her past data.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Nakayama Festa was asked about 
her goals by her classmate Tosen Jordan. 
...Classic year is for scouting. Goals 
still undecided.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When she replied, “Right now, I'm not 
aiming for anything,” Tosen Jordan gave a 
relieved smile. Seeing that reaction left 
her tilting her head in wonder.
